We killed our AI strategy last week.

Nobody noticed.

Six weeks ago we had a 14-page deck, a steering committee and a Notion board with 41 “AI initiatives”. Last Tuesday I archived the board. The three agents we actually run in prod kept running. One of them registered a domain in staging on Thursday, which is the most initiative anything on that board ever showed.

The deck is still in the shared drive if anyone wants a 14-page description of things that never shipped.

Turns out the strategy was the three agents. The rest was a PDF nobody opened.
